note: TWO HALVES, DELIBERATELY DIFFERENT. `entries` holds sha256 digests of normalised slurs and never the strings themselves: a slur list checked into a repository in plaintext is an evasion guide with a table of contents, and the hash set answers the only question stage 1 asks of it - is this normalised token in the set. `plaintextPhrases` holds ideological phrases whose only reading is the hateful one; those need substring matching, which a hash cannot do, and publishing them teaches an attacker nothing. STATUS IS `unconfigured` AND THAT IS FAIL-CLOSED: with no operator slur list loaded, packages/screening raises `lexicon_unconfigured` and paid media is forbidden until it is. Missing list, no clearance. Load the operator list with the digests computed by hashTerm() from @fee-split-vaults/catalog and set status to `configured`. This file is ADDITIVE to DEFAULT_LEXICON in packages/screening/src/lexicon.ts, which already carries the built-in hate, tragedy, sexual, violence and minor-reference terms.

plaintextPhrases.note: Eugenic framing. Distinct from the vaccine-era usage, which is why it is a phrase and not a word.
